name: pico-repo-map-localization-v4-frozen
description: Five independent localization-heavy tasks over one multi-package service repository, frozen before the first live-model evaluation. Each task crosses module boundaries and includes legacy or experimental distractors.

tasks.prompt: Fix the public checkout quote_order flow. Shipping must use the requested region's rate table when that region exists; only an absent region may fall back to the default table. A missing method in the selected table, or a missing region when the default is absent, must raise KeyError. Keep subtotal and total amounts in integer cents, leave the order and rate table unchanged, preserve the public APIs, and run the tests.

Fix the public webhook handle_event flow. A delivery is a duplicate only when both tenant_id and event_id match a successfully processed delivery. Different tenants may reuse an event_id. If the handler raises, that delivery must remain retryable; a later successful retry is then recorded. Missing tenant_id or event_id must raise KeyError before calling the handler or changing the store. Preserve the public APIs and return values, and run the tests.

Complete permission resolution behind the public authorize flow. Each role definition has permissions and may inherit other role names. Effective permissions must include transitive inheritance across all of a user's roles, deduplicate permissions, raise KeyError for any unknown direct or inherited role, and raise ValueError("role inheritance cycle") for a cycle. Leave the user and role definitions unchanged, preserve the public APIs, and run the tests.

Fix the public rename_catalog_item flow so a successful slug rename invalidates exactly the product-id view plus both old- and new-slug views, while preserving unrelated cache entries. Renaming to the current slug is a complete no-op. An unknown item raises KeyError; a slug owned by another item raises ValueError; either failure leaves both catalog and cache unchanged. Missing cache keys are harmless. Preserve the public APIs and run the tests.

Fix the public receipt render_receipt flow. Template lookup order must be exact locale, then the base language for a hyphenated locale, then default. For example pt-BR prefers pt-BR, otherwise pt, otherwise default. If every candidate is absent, raise KeyError. Render with the event values, leave the event and templates unchanged, preserve the public APIs, and run the tests.
